explicitly_unsupported: bigint conversion (no reachable grammar return type)
Date conversion (no reachable grammar return type)
non-ASCII dynamic rule/type names outside the pinned grammar domain
CST rule-call/cross-reference resolution; caller supplies resolved dispatch
string_policy: Raw lexeme retained as UTF-8; result contains UTF-16 units so source slicing can retain lone surrogates. STRING_VALUE and UNRESTRICTED_NAME stay quoted. Name sanitation is a separate function.
number_policy: Validate ECMAScript numeric-string grammar before std binary64 decimal parse; preserve signed zero/NaN/infinities. Unsigned binary/octal/hex integers use explicit guard/sticky ties-to-even rounding. INT uses decimal/hex prefix semantics. Full runtime number equivalence remains unverified.
presence_policy: Undefined, Null and Value are separate; converter is invoked only for Value.
limits: Explicit UTF-16-unit allocation budget, pre/during-materialization/post cancellation checks. The bounded stdlib decimal parse cannot be preempted.
